about: Refresh of 2026-11-15 (night): the sixth signals push and its review (CLAIMS SG28-SG32: nine signals, the meetings, no gun survives an echo, the reflector works once, the events review 5 had not followed). Every quote is checked by collect.py against research/NOTEBOOK.md, research/CLAIMS.md or the named file; the train's cells are copied from research/signals/objects/echo-train.json and the nine signals read from research/audit/signals6/sig6.py.

audits.label: Review of the sixth signals push
audits.line: Own steppers and two SAT encodings: nine signals, not four; every meeting at every offset, the fronts proved for ever by a script; 67 guns, none survives an echo even if it may answer with anything; the reflector works once; the events review 5 had not followed, followed.

milestones.text: The sixth signals push: four signals on the stream; they do not pass each other; no gun survives an echo
The sixth signals push reviewed: nine signals; the meetings proved for ever
